summary: Attic. Inspection -> estimate -> remediation -> clearance -> paid in full
property: 2575 Rue de la Canardiere, Laval, QC (house)
client: Previous owner (sold the house); the new owners asked for an inspection
client_concern: Booking note: the client sold the house. A bathroom fan problem had caused some discoloration in the attic; he sprayed an anti-mold product and thought it was fine. The new owners contacted him and asked for a proper inspection to confirm if there is mold. Office note: 'Please do a full diagnostic inspection and don't forget a swab test.'

timeline.what: Client support (Danica) books the inspection for Aug 26 at 1 PM, $195 + tax. The calendar entry also gets an automatic AI 'financial analysis' of the area.
Inspector checks the attic: humidity, moisture, smell, swab test.
Inspector posts findings, the estimate ('$1500+tax, 4 hours, 1-2 person team') and 17 photos. 'Please invoice.'
Inspection invoice MU693 ($224.20, paid). Inspection report written and reviewed the same day. Estimate MO881 created at $1,543 + tax. Asana card created at 16:33.
Automated SMS: 'I sent you the estimate earlier...'. 11 minutes later the client replies: 'Go ahead with a job and let me know when'. Support asks them to accept the estimate.
Estimate marked accepted, booking deposit ($617.20) sent and paid. Card moves to 'Active Projects'.
'Your project is booked - optional add-ons before we start'.
Clearance report (grade 4, swab tests negative) and final invoice sent. The report includes 3 screenshots of the crew's Telegram messages with their notes. Card tagged PROJECT COMPLETED.
SMS with the payment link (card or e-transfer). Paid the same evening.
Two automated SMS asking for a Google review.

estimate_items_from_freshbooks.description:
The inspector who prepared this estimate is:
Joshua Lebrun, MSC ME, CMI

Got questions? Contact Josh by phone at: (514) 500-5801

--1 - Containment of Contaminated Area(s)

Containment of the affected areas with polyethylene drop sheets and zipper door(s), using negative air pressure (If permitted by actual conditions at the property), or an equivalent method, in order to prevent the cross-contamination of mold spores, dust/debris, and other particulates to other areas of the property.

Additionally, any personal belongings or large items that cannot be relocated within the affected area will be individually wrapped to 
them against dust and debris during the remediation process.

- Ordinary air scrubber deployment


-Topical Treatment Process:

Removal of mold from the areas by means of manual wire brushing or other topical and abrasive removal techniques. This is done in conjunction with HEPA vacuuming, and the application of an advanced, two-stage mold remediation protocol, initiating with high-precision stain removal techniques to revitalize the aesthetics of affected surfaces. This is seamlessly followed by the strategic application of our proprietary fungicides, meticulously designed to eliminate mold spores, thereby ensuring your space is restored to its pristine condition and safeguarded against future contamination.

The areas & materials that require treatment are:
Small Areas:
- near bathroom exhaust fan
- two other areas with small mold patches
- any other small patch if the team notices more
- other surfaces
Residual non-fungal staining may be present upon completion.

-- 3 - Cleaning and Disinfection

Thorough HEPA vacuuming is conducted throughout all surfaces in the affected area in order to remove mold spores, particulates, and dust.
All remaining surfaces (studs, beams, walls, floors, etc.) in the affected areas will be disinfected by concentrated fogging, using an approved fungicide.

Additional vacuuming or HEPA air scrubbing may occur upon completion of the fogging process, along with a general cleaning of all areas traveled by Mold Busters personnel.
Mold Busters applies an advanced, two-stage mold remediation protocol, initiating with high-precision stain removal techniques to revitalize the aesthetics of affected surfaces. This is seamlessly followed by the strategic application of our proprietary fungicides, meticulously designed to eliminate mold spores, thereby ensuring your space is restored to its pristine condition and safeguarded against future contamination.

-- 4 - Post-Removal Clearance (Swab)
Post-remediation verification is conducted to ensure that the environment has been successfully remediated.
The final clearance inspection includes a visual inspection and an instant swab analysis.

This will be performed by the Project Supervisor upon completion of the remediation process.

-- Project Clearance Report
A written report following the remediation process, describing the outcome of the remediation work, any potential source issues, clearance grades, etc.

Additional recommendations will be made in this report to assist in preventing future fungal contamination.
